fx_rate_source: Frozen 2026-10-28 audit-date reference rates: ECB daily reference rates and same-day EUR cross-rates; official central-bank market/reference rates; and documented fixed pegs. See the per-currency provenance entries.
hourly_work_year_assumption: 40 hours per week × 52 weeks = 2,080 hours; daily uses five 8-hour workdays per week × 52 weeks = 260 workdays.

USD.source_note: USD is the reporting base currency; no market conversion is applied to USD.

KWD.reference: Central Bank of Kuwait chart labels the series in Fils; on 28/10/2026 it reports 308.350 fils per USD, so 1 USD = 0.308350 KWD and 1 KWD = 1000/308.350 USD.
KWD.source_note: The official CBK page labels the chart unit 'Fils' and the series 'KWD to US Dollar Exchange Rate'; this confirms the 308.350 quote is fils per USD, not KWD per USD.
